units.source_text: 厢房中间的纸隔扇尽行撤去，各处但用帷屏遮隔。

en.t: The paper sliding partitions between the side rooms had all been removed, and each area was separated only by curtains and screens.

units.source_text: 中央设置源氏主君座位。

en.t: Genji's seat was placed in the center.

units.source_text: 今日为琴筝作伴奏的笛，令男童吹奏。

en.t: The flutes that would accompany the koto and zither that day were assigned to young boys.

units.source_text: 髭黑右大臣家三公子——即玉鬘所生长子——吹笙，夕雾左大将家大公子吹横笛，都坐在廊下。

en.t: The third son of the Minister of the Right with the black beard, Tamakazura's eldest child, played the sho, while the eldest son of Yugiri, the General of the Left, played the transverse flute; both sat out on the veranda.

units.source_text: 室内铺着茵褥，放着各种弦乐器。

en.t: Inside, cushions were spread out and all kinds of stringed instruments were set in place.

units.source_text: 家中秘藏的各种琴，都装在华丽的藏青色袋内，此时全部取出。

en.t: All the treasured zithers kept in the household, stored in splendid deep blue bags, were now brought out.

units.source_text: 明石夫人弹琵琶，紫夫人弹和琴，明石女御弹筝。

en.t: Lady Akashi played the biwa, Lady Murasaki played the wagon, and the Akashi Consort played the zither.

units.source_text: 三公主并不擅长此种大型的琴，源氏体会她的心情，便把她平日惯用的七弦琴调整，交与她弹。

en.t: The Third Princess was not skilled with such a large instrument, so Genji understood how she felt, tuned the seven-stringed zither she usually used, and handed it to her to play.

units.source_text: 他说：“筝的弦线并非常常会松弛，只因和别的乐器合奏时，琴柱的位置容易变动，所以必须预先顾到，张得紧些。

en.t: He said, "The strings of the zither do not often go slack, but when it is played with other instruments the bridges can easily shift, so one must think ahead and tune the strings a little tighter.

units.source_text: 女子腕力较弱，不宜张弦，还是叫夕雾大将来张吧。

en.t: Women have weaker arms and are not suited to tightening the strings, so let us ask General Yugiri to come and do it.

units.source_text: 这班吹笛的人，还都是孩子，能否合拍，很不可靠呢。”

en.t: These flute players are still only children, so there is no telling whether they will keep proper time."

units.source_text: 便笑着派人去召唤夕雾：“请大将到这儿来！”

en.t: Then, laughing, he sent someone to summon Yugiri: "Please ask the General to come here!"

units.source_text: 许多妇女怕难为情，心情紧张起来。

en.t: Many of the women grew tense, afraid of being embarrassed.

units.source_text: 除了明石夫人以外，其余都是源氏的入室弟子，因此他也很担心，希望她们都弹得好，使夕雾听了无可非难。

en.t: Apart from Lady Akashi, all the others were Genji's own pupils, so he too was anxious and hoped they would all play well enough that Yugiri could find no fault in them.

units.source_text: 他想：“女御在皇上面前，惯于和其他乐器合奏，大可放心。

en.t: He thought, "The Consort is used to playing with other instruments before the Emperor, so I can feel quite at ease about her.

units.source_text: 只是紫夫人的和琴，弦线虽然不多，而弹法无有定规，女子奏此乐器，往往会张皇失措。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki's wagon, though it has few strings, has no fixed method of playing, and women who perform on it often become flustered.

units.source_text: 合奏之时，别的弦乐器全都协调，这和琴会不会变调呢？”

en.t: When they play together, even if all the other stringed instruments are in tune, might this wagon fall out of key?"
He was worried on Lady Murasaki's behalf.
